questions.question: It was only when I had finished my homework that I realized I had forgotten to buy milk. What did you do?
options: I had bought the milk before I started my homework.
You were the one who forgot to buy milk.
I had done all my homework by the time I remembered the milk.
It was only when I had finished buying milk that I realized I had forgotten to do my homework.
questions.answer: I had bought the milk before I started my homework.

questions.question: Although it's been raining all day, we still have a lot of work to do in the garden. What can be inferred about the speaker and their task?
options: They are trying to build a new house.
They are planning to go on holiday soon.
They are still able to complete their gardening tasks despite the rain.
They are giving up on their gardening project due to the bad weather.
questions.answer: They are still able to complete their gardening tasks despite the rain.

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left. What would have been a more polite way for the host to say this?
options: I'm afraid you're just in time for the leftovers.
You've missed the main event, but there's still some cake left.
Most people had already gone home when I arrived, but it was nice of them to stay for me.
You're lucky you didn't have to stand around all evening waiting for more guests.
questions.answer: Most people had already gone home when I arrived, but it was nice of them to stay for me.

questions.question: The new policy has been implemented in order that employees can work more efficiently. What is the main purpose of the policy?
options: To reduce employee turnover rates.
To increase employee productivity and efficiency.
To provide better working conditions for all staff members.
To introduce a new dress code for office workers.
questions.answer: To increase employee productivity and efficiency.

questions.question: It is not until I have finished my studies that I will be able to pursue my dream of becoming an artist. What can be inferred about the speaker's current situation?
options: They are currently working as a professional artist.
They are still in school and studying art.
They are planning to travel the world before starting their career.
They have already achieved success as an artist.
questions.answer: They are still in school and studying art.
